01.title: Ɔsesaeɛ ho Sini: Sɛdeɛ Nsuo Hyɛ Ɛpo Ma
01.description: P2P ɔsesaeɛ no, n'adehunu ne ne Bible mu fapem, ne asuafoɔ yɛ adwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa – sɛdeɛ nsuo hyɛ ɛpo ma.

units.u001: Na Awurade animuonyam ho nimdeɛ bɛhyɛ asase nyinaa ma, sɛdeɛ nsuo hyɛ ɛpo ma no.
units.u002: Susu wiase bi a Onyankopɔn animuonyam ho nimdeɛ ahyɛ asase so ma, sɛdeɛ nsuo hyɛ ɛpo ma.
units.u003: Ɛnyɛ nimdeɛ a wɔde sie asɔredan mu, anaa wɔka no nyamesom nkɔmmɔ mu nko…
units.u004: na mmom nimdeɛ a ɛhyɛ sɛdeɛ nnipa bɔ wɔn bra no kwan.
units.u009: Ne sɛdeɛ mpɔtam hwɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho.
units.u010: Yei ne Habakuk adehunu, tiri abien, nkyekyɛmu dunan.
units.u011: Na ɛso sene adan biara, nhyiamu biara…
units.u013: Anadwo a ɛdi asɛndua no anim no, Yesu bɔɔ mpaeɛ maa N'akyidifoɔ.
units.u014: Memmisa wo sɛ yi wɔn firi ewiase, na mmom, mesrɛ sɛ, bɔ wɔn ho ban firi ɔbonsam nsam.
units.u015: Sɛdeɛ memfiri ewiase no, saa ara nso na wɔmfiri ewiase.
units.u018: Ɛnam Kristo so, yɛanya nkwa a ɛfiri Onyankopɔn.
units.u019: Ɛnam Ne bɔhyɛ so, yɛwɔ Ne su kronkron no mu kyɛfa.
units.u020: Na Onyankopɔn pɛ sɛ wɔhunu Ne nkwa wɔ yɛn mu: Ne su, Ne nyansa ne Ne dɔ, wɔ yɛn nsɛm, yɛn gyinaeɛ, yɛn nkitahodie, yɛn adwuma ne yɛn som mu.
units.u021: Yɛkura saa ademudeɛ yi wɔ dɔteɛ nkukuo mu, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛhunu sɛ tumi no firi Onyankopɔn, na ɛnnfiri yɛn.
units.u022: Yɛyɛ nkukuo, sɛdeɛ Yesu nkwa bɛda adi wɔ yɛn nipadua a ɛbɛwu mu.
units.u023: Na sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn dɔɔ ewiase nie; sɛ ɔde ne Ba a ɔwoo no korɔ no maeɛ.
units.u024: Kristo baeɛ na ɔde Ne nkwa maeɛ sɛdeɛ ewiase bɛnya nkwa.
units.u025: Ɔwu maa obiara, sɛdeɛ wɔn a wɔte ase no rentena ase mma wɔn ho bio, na mmom wɔbɛtena ase ama No.
units.u026: Ɔanwu sɛdeɛ nkwagyeɛ asɛm no bɛtena nnipa kakraa bi nkyɛn.
units.u027: Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na nnipa bɛgye Deɛ wɔntee Ne ho asɛm da no adi?
units.u028: Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔate, gye sɛ obi ka kyerɛ wɔn?
units.u029: Ɛsɛ sɛ Kristo asɛm no tu kwan.
units.u030: Firi akoma baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so.
units.u031: Firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so.
units.u032: Firi ɔman baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so.
units.u033: Afahyɛ no da a ɛdi akyire a ɛyɛ da titire no, Yesu sɔre gyinaa hɔ kasaa denden sɛ: Obiara a osukɔm de no no mmra me nkyɛn mmɛnom nsuo.
units.u034: Na Atwerɛsɛm no ka sɛ, Obiara a ɔgye me di no, nsuo a ɛma nkwa bɛtene afiri ne mu.
units.u035: Na ɔreka Honhom no ho asɛm.
units.u036: Nkwa nsuo no yɛ Ne deɛ, ɛnnyɛ yɛn deɛ.
units.u037: Na deɛ Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ yɛn mu no, n'atirimpɔ nnyɛ sɛ ɛbɛgyae wɔ yɛn nkyɛn.
units.u039: Nokorɛ biara a wɔde kyerɛ afoforɔ.
units.u042: Akoma biara a wɔhyɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnhunu Kristo.
units.u043: Emu biara bɛyɛ Ne nkwa a ɛsene kɔ ewiase mu no nkyerɛkyerɛmu foforɔ.
units.u044: Susu sɛ ogyidini biara bɛyɛ kuruwa.
units.u045: Susu sɛ kuruwa biara ma nkwa nsuo no sene.
units.u046: Nsuo bɔta baako bɛtumi ayɛ ketewa.
units.u047: Asubɔnten baako bɛtumi ayɛ deɛ ɛwɔ ano.
units.u048: Nanso sɛ nkwa bebree a wɔntumi nkan kura Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ na wɔde kyerɛ afoforɔ a, nsunsuansoɔ no kɔ akyiri sene deɛ yɛn mu biara bɛtumi ayɛ ne nko.
units.u052: Yɛbom de Awurade animuonyam ho nimdeɛ kyerɛ afoforɔ, kɔsi sɛ asase bɛyɛ ma…
units.u054: Ɛno nti na asuafoɔ yɛ ho hia.
units.u055: Ɛno nti na adesua ho hia.
units.u056: Deɛ yɛnya no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ deɛ yɛde bɔ yɛn bra, na deɛ yɛsua no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ deɛ yɛboa afoforɔ ma wɔte aseɛ.
units.u057: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako de nokorɛ hyɛ ɔfoforɔ nsa.
units.u058: Nkwa baako boa nkwa foforɔ ma ɛnyini.
units.u059: Fa nsɛm a wotee sɛ mereka akyerɛ adansedifoɔ bebree no, na fa hyɛ nnipa a wogye wɔn di na wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ afoforɔ nso nsa.
units.u061: Wɔ Timoteo nwoma a ɛtɔ so abien, tiri abien, nkyekyɛmu abien mu, Paulo kyerɛkyerɛ nokorɛdie nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn bi mu.
units.u062: Deɛ wɔanya no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde hyɛ nnipa nokwafoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ afoforɔ nso nsa.

units.u068: Saa na nimdeɛ, nokorɛdie ne asuafoɔ yɛ firi onipa baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so, ne firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako so kɔ deɛ ɛdi so.
units.u070: Ɛnyɛ sɛ yɛbɛnim pii nko nti na yɛsua.
units.u071: Yɛsua sɛdeɛ yɛbɛyɛ ahwɛfoɔ nokwafoɔ wɔ deɛ wɔde ama yɛn so: sɛ yɛbɛbɔ yɛn bra nyansam, yɛasom yie, yɛde mmoa a mfasoɔ wɔ so aka ho, na yɛaboa afoforɔ ma wɔanyini.
units.u072: Ɛsɛ sɛ adesua kɔ akyiri sene nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ wo nko.
units.u074: ne nokorɛ no ase a wobɛte.
units.u078: ne sɛ wobɛma nokorɛ no ahyɛ deɛ yɛbɛyɛ no kwan.
units.u080: ne sɛ wode deɛ yɛasua no bɛsom afoforɔ.

units.u083: Kyerɛwnsɛm a wobɛkenkan na woakɔ wo kwan nnyɛ botaeɛ no.
units.u084: Adesua baako a wobɛwie nnyɛ botaeɛ no.

units.u086: Botaeɛ no ne asetena a asesa…
units.u087: ne asetena a ɛboa ma afoforɔ sesa.

units.u092: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako siesie deɛ ɛdi so.
units.u095: Ɛsɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ duru nnipa asetena fa biara.
units.u096: Wɔ agumadie mu, ɛte sɛ nokorɛdie, ahohyɛso ne nkabom.
units.u097: Wɔ mfiridwuma mu, ano aduro a wɔyɛ no asodie mu, ma nnipa yiedie.
units.u098: Wɔ adwumadie mu, nokorɛdie, ahwɛyie pa ne adeyɛ pa.
units.u099: Wɔ nhomasua mu, nimdeɛ a wɔde kyerɛ afoforɔ de nkɔsoɔ ba nnipa mu.
units.u100: Wɔ nyansahu mu, nokorɛ a wɔhwehwɛ no yie.

units.u102: Wɔ apɔmuden ho hwɛ mu, ayamhyehyeɛ.

02.title: P2P Global Adehunu
02.description: Deɛ enti a P2P wɔ hɔ: obiara sua firi obi hɔ na ɔboa obi ma ɔnyini, firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.

units.u001: Gyidie mu asetena biara fi aseɛ firi obi a ne ho hiaa no sɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ afoforɔ.
units.u002: Ɛna bi a ɔne ne ba buee Kyerɛwnsɛm no.
units.u003: Adamfo bi a ɔkyerɛɛ deɛ adom kyerɛ ankasa.
units.u004: Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bi a ɔtenaa hɔ sɛ ɔbɛyi asɛmmisa foforɔ bio ano.
units.u005: Obi de nokorɛ no kyerɛɛ wɔn.
units.u006: Na seesei, wɔde kyerɛ obi foforɔ.
units.u007: Saa na gyidie atrɛw daa: firi onipa baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so, firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako so kɔ deɛ ɛdi so.
units.u008: Paulo ka kyerɛɛ Timoteo sɛ ɔmfa deɛ ɔnya no nhyɛ nnipa nokwafoɔ a wɔbɛtumi akyerɛ afoforɔ nso nsa.
units.u009: Ogyidini baako boa ɔfoforɔ ma ɔnyini.
units.u010: Saa ogyidini no nso boa obi foforɔ.
units.u015: Kɔsi sɛ Awurade animuonyam ho nimdeɛ bɛhyɛ asase so ma, sɛdeɛ nsuo hyɛ ɛpo ma.

03.title: Akwaaba wɔ P2P
03.description: P2P mu nhwehwɛmu a ɛdi kan: Fie, Adesua, Bible, Nkrasɛm ne nea aka – ne sɛdeɛ ne nyinaa bɔ mu.

units.u001: Akwaaba wɔ P2P Global, Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network.
units.u002: P2P yɛ beaeɛ a wobɛsua Onyankopɔn Asɛm, ate ase, de abɔ wo bra, na woaboa obi foforɔ ma wanyini.
units.u003: Ma yɛnkyini nhwɛ ntɛm, na woahunu baabi a biribiara wɔ.
units.u005: Da biara wobɛhunu Ɛnnɛ Asɛm: nkyekyɛmu baako ne akwankyerɛ tiawa a ɛbɛboa wo ma wode adi dwuma.
units.u006: Wobɛtumi abue tiri no nyinaa, atie, na woahunu wo nyini anamɔn ntɛm.
units.u007: Adesua fa no ne baabi a wonyini wɔ ntease mu.
units.u008: Kingdom School de wo fa Fapem Nsɛm no mu, adesua baako biara.
units.u009: Kingdom Stories bue Bible mu abakɔsɛm ma wo.
units.u010: P2P Nhyehyɛeɛ boa wo ma wosua asɛmti bi wɔ wo ankasa mmerɛ so, na Yɛmmɔ Mu Nsua ma wo kwan ma wo ne afoforɔ sua bom.
units.u011: Wɔ Bible fa no, wobɛtumi akenkan Kyerɛwnsɛm no wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ ne kasa bebree mu.
units.u012: Fa nnwom afidie no tie, hyɛ nkyekyɛmu a ɛka wo koma no nsɔano, fa nkyerɛaseɛ toto ho, na hwehwɛ Bible no nyinaa mu.
units.u013: Nkrasɛm ma wo nkitahodie kɔ so bɛn wo.
units.u014: Wo ne nnipa a mo ne wɔn sua nkɔmmɔ, yɛ akuo kokoam, na kyerɛw nkrataa tenten wɔ P2P Mail so.
units.u015: Wɔ Pii ase, wobɛhunu Mpaeɛbɔ, a akwan a wɔkyerɛ, Asɛm no mu mpaeɛbɔ, ne mpaeɛ nkrataa wom.
units.u016: Wobɛhunu Hwehwɛ nso, baabi a wo ne agyidifoɔ afoforɔ bɛhyia, wobɛhunu w'asɔre, na woahwehwɛ asɛmpatrɛw adwuma mu.
units.u017: Me Ho Nsɛm ka wo ho asɛm: wo nyini, wo asuafoɔ nkitahodie, ne w'akwantuo firi Aba so kɔ Mfifiriɛ, Dua Ketewa, Dua a Ɛso Aba, kɔsi Kwaeɛ Sifoɔ.
units.u018: Nyini wɔ ha kyerɛ anamɔn ankasa a woatu.
units.u019: Ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔde susu wo boɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn anim.
units.u020: Enti fi aseɛ firi ɛnnɛ asɛm no so.

04.title: Ɛdeɛn ne Peer Guide?
04.description: Deɛ Peer Guide yɛ, deɛ enti a akwankyerɛ wɔ hɔ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ ne obi a ɔrenyini nam.

units.u001: Dwene obi a wo ne no kaa Yesu ho asɛm: adamfo, ɔfipamfoɔ, obi a wohyiaa no prɛko pɛ.
units.u003: Ɔkenkan Bible, nanso ɔwɔ nsɛmmisa, na ɔnnim baabi a ɔmfi aseɛ.
units.u004: Gyidie mu nyini nnyɛ adeɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ obi yɛ no ɔno nko.
units.u005: Kyerɛwnsɛm ka sɛ baanu yɛ sene ɔbaakofoɔ.
units.u006: Sɛ ɔbaako hwe ase a, ne yɔnko bɛboa no ma ɔsɔre.
units.u007: Adɛn nti na yei ho hia?
units.u008: Ɛfiri sɛ gyidie nyini yie wɔ nkitahodie mu.
units.u009: Ɛnyɛ nnipadɔm nko na Yesu kyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn.
units.u010: Ɔyii kuo ketewa bi sɛ wɔne No ntena: ɔne wɔn didiiɛ, ɔyii wɔn nsɛmmisa ano, na ɔne wɔn bɔɔ mpaeɛ.
units.u011: Na agyidifoɔ a wɔdii kan no nso nyiniiɛ saa ara, na wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho nkuran da biara.
units.u012: Wɔ P2P mu, Peer Guide yɛ ogyidini a ɔdi wo anim anammɔn baako wɔ asuafoɔ akwantuo no so.
units.u013: Ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ anaa ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, na mmom obi a ɔanante kwan yi so ansa na woreba, na wasiesie ne ho sɛ ɔne wo bɛnante seesei.
units.u014: Wo Peer Guide ne wo sua adesua no, ɔyi wo nsɛmmisa ano, ɔhwɛ wo nsusuiɛ mu, na ɔne wo bɔ mpaeɛ.
units.u015: Fa no sɛ honhom mu adamfo a ɔwɔ osuahunu kakra ka ho.
units.u016: Wobɛtumi abisa Peer Guide berɛ a woka P2P ho kan.
units.u017: Kyerɛw nkyia tiawa bi, na wobɛtumi afi w'akwantuo ase ntɛm ara, berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ onipa a ɔfata ama wo.
units.u018: Akyire yi, wobɛtumi abue Hwehwɛ Peer Guide berɛ biara na woahwehwɛ obi a ɔfata wo.
units.u019: Peer Guide nsi Kristo, Kyerɛwnsɛm, wo sɔfoɔ, anaa Honhom Kronkron adwuma ananmu.
units.u020: Paulo kaa no tiawa: Meduaa, Apolo guguu so nsuo, nanso Onyankopɔn na ɔmaa ɛnyiniiɛ.
units.u021: Peer Guide yɛ ɔhokafoɔ wɔ ɛkwan so.
units.u022: Na da bi, onipa a wɔkyerɛɛ no kwan no bɛyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ.
units.u023: Deɛ woanya no, wode ma obi a ɔwɔ w'akyi anammɔn baako.
units.u024: Saa na asuafoɔ yɛ nyini: firi asetena baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so, ne firi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ baako so kɔ deɛ ɛdi so.
units.u025: Obiara sua firi obi hɔ, na ɔboa obi ma ɔnyini.
units.u027: Na hwan na wo ne no bɛnante?

overlays.l02: Peer Guide yɛ ogyidini a ɔdi wo anim anammɔn baako wɔ akwantuo no so.
overlays.l04: “Meduaa aba no na Apolo guguu so nsuo nanso Onyankopɔn na ɔmaa afifideɛ no nyiniiɛ.”

05.title: Asɔre a Ɛyɛ Asuafoɔ
05.description: Sɛdeɛ P2P boa asɔre asuafoɔ adwuma: ntuanofoɔ siesie, asɔremma ho hwɛ, ne nnipa soma.

units.u001: Ansa na Ɔrekɔ soro no, Yesu de adwuma a ɛda adi maa N'asɔre: monkɔ nkɔyɛ amanaman nyinaa asuafoɔ, na monkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ma wɔnni deɛ Ɔhyɛeɛ nyinaa so.
units.u002: Asuafoɔ yɛ ayɛ daa wɔ asɔre asetena mu.
units.u004: Ɛnam akuo nketewa a wɔboaboa wɔn ho ano wɔ Bible a wɔabue ho so.
units.u006: Na ɛnam ayɔnkofa so, baabi a ogyidini baako boa ɔfoforɔ ma ɔnyini.
units.u007: Kristo de asɔfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ maeɛ sɛ wɔnsiesie Ne nkurɔfoɔ mma ɔsom adwuma.
units.u008: Nanso Kwasiada ne Kwasiada ntam no, ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛhunu hwan na ɔrenyini, hwan na ɔrebrɛ, ne anammɔn a ɛdi so a obiara bɛtu.
units.u009: Wɔyɛɛ P2P Global sɛ ɛbɛboa asɔre bi ma ayɛ saa adwuma yi den, ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛbɛsi n'ananmu.
units.u010: Asɔre bɛtumi akyerɛw ne din wɔ P2P so kwa, de koodu ato nsa afrɛ n'asɔremma, na ama wɔn beaeɛ baako a wɔbɛsua na wɔanyini abom.
units.u011: Wɔ asɔre fa no mu, ntuanofoɔ hunu asɔre nkɔmmɔ, fael ne nneɛma a ɛboa, nhyiamu, akuo nketewa, ne dawuroboɔ.
units.u012: Asɔremma bɛtumi adi Kingdom School fapem nsɛm no akyi na wɔasua abom, na obiara kura ne nkɔsoɔ.
units.u013: Asɔre bɛtumi asua Kingdom School adesua koro no, anaa Kingdom Story koro no abom.
units.u014: Akuo nketewa bɛtumi ayɛ ho adwuma wɔ wɔn ankasa mmerɛ so, berɛ a asɔremma biara kura ne nkɔsoɔ ne ne nsusuiɛ.
units.u015: Wɔ ɛkwan so, asɔremma yi nsɛmmisa tiawa ano, na wɔkyerɛw wɔn ankasa nsusuiɛ wɔ wɔn asuafoɔ nkrataa mu, sɛdeɛ adesua bɛyɛ ntease, na ntease bɛyɛ asetena a asesa.
units.u016: Mpɔtam nhwɛsoɔ kyerɛ nnipa dodoɔ a wɔresua ankasa.
units.u017: Ɛkyerɛ nso brɛoo asɔremma a wɔnyɛɛ hwee berɛ bi, ne agyidifoɔ foforɔ a wonnya ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ, sɛdeɛ obiara rentwe ne ho kɔ komm.
units.u018: Na ɛsiane sɛ asuafoɔ yɛ nnyae wɔ asɔre pono ano nti, abusua bɛtumi ayɛ Abusua Kuo de abɔ mpaeɛ na wɔasua abom wɔ fie, berɛ a Peer Guides boa agyidifoɔ foforɔ ma wɔne obi a ɔdi wɔn anim anammɔn baako nante.
units.u019: P2P nsi wo sɔfoɔ, asɔre a ɛhyia, anaa Honhom Kronkron adwuma ananmu.
units.u020: Ɛyɛ adwinnadeɛ a ɛboa asafo ma ɛyɛ deɛ Kyerɛwnsɛm akyerɛ dada: agyidifoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ma asomafoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ayɔnkofa, na wɔde deɛ wɔanya ahyɛ nnipa nokwafoɔ a wɔbɛkyerɛ afoforɔ nso nsa.
units.u021: Asɔre a ɛyɛ asuafoɔ ma nnipa a wɔyɛ asuafoɔ sɔre, wɔ wɔn afie mu, wɔn adwumabea, ne wɔn mpɔtam.
units.u022: Fa w'asɔre bra P2P Global, na monnyini mmom.

overlays.l01: “Enti, monkɔ nkɔyɛ amanaman nyinaa mʼasuafoɔ… na monkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛ, wɔnni deɛ mahyɛ mo no nyinaa so.”
overlays.l02: “…na afoforɔ nso yɛɛ asɔfoɔ ne akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ yei de siesiee Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa maa ɔsom nnwuma, sɛdeɛ Kristo onipadua no nyini bɛkɔso”
overlays.l03: Kyerɛw w'asɔre din – kwa, wontua hwee
overlays.l04: “Daa na wɔde wɔn adagyeɛ nyinaa sua asomafoɔ no nkyerɛkyerɛ. Wɔne wɔn nyaa ayɔnkofa, hyia didi bɔɔ mu ne wɔn bɔɔ mpaeɛ.”
overlays.outro2: Monnyini mmom. Monyɛ asuafoɔ a wɔbɛyɛ asuafoɔ.

06.title: Bible no ne Adesua a Emu Dɔ
06.description: Kenkan Bible no wɔ wo kasa mu, na sua no yie wɔ nnwinnadeɛ a ɛboa ntease ho.

units.u001: Kyerɛwnsɛm yɛ Onyankopɔn asɛm ma yɛn.
units.u002: Odwontofoɔ no frɛɛ no kanea ma ne nan ne hann wɔ ne kwan so.
units.u003: Ɛfata sɛ wohwɛ mu sene ntɛm ara.
units.u004: Berɛ a Beroiafoɔ tee asɛm no, wɔde ahosɛpɛ gyee no, na daa wɔsuaa Atwerɛsɛm no.
units.u005: Wɔyɛɛ P2P sɛ ɛbɛboa wo ma woayɛ saa ara: akenkan, atie, ate ase, na de deɛ wohunu no abɔ wo bra.
units.u006: Bue Bible fa no, na yi nwoma ne tiri biara.
units.u007: Kenkan wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ ne kasa bebree mu, na sesa firi baako so kɔ ɔfoforɔ so berɛ biara a wopɛ.
units.u008: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotie a, nnwom afidie no kenkan Kyerɛwnsɛm no denden, sɛdeɛ Asɛm no bɛka wo ho berɛ a worenante, woreyɛ adwuma, anaa wode wo ho ahome.
units.u009: Ɛkwan pa a wobɛfa so afi aseɛ no nyɛ den.
units.u011: Bisa deɛ ɛkyerɛ wo fa Onyankopɔn, nnipa, ne sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wobɔ wo bra ho.
units.u012: Afei fa bɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛ Onyankopɔn, na hwehwɛ ɛkwan baako a wobɛfa so ayɛ asoɔmmerɛ ɛnnɛ.
units.u013: Yi nkyekyɛmu bi na hyɛ no nsɔano, na kora no wɔ wo Bible akorabea.
units.u014: Fa nkyekyɛmu bi wɔ nkyerɛaseɛ ahodoɔ mu toto ho.
units.u015: Na hwehwɛ asɛmfua anaa asɛmti bi wɔ Bible no nyinaa mu.
units.u016: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokɔ akyiri a, Bible Adesua bue beaeɛ soronko ma adesua a wɔhwɛ yie.
units.u017: Wɔ Adesua a Emu Dɔ mu, wobɛhunu Bible nsɛmfua nkyerɛaseɛ nwoma, nkrataa a wɔde kyerɛ, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nsɛmfua adesua nnwinnadeɛ a ɛkyerɛ deɛ nsɛmfua a ɛdi kan no kyerɛ.
units.u018: Adesua a Emu Dɔ nsi Bible akenkan ananmu.
units.u020: Wodi kan kenkan nsɛm no, afei wosua no yie, sɛdeɛ ntease bɛkɔ gyidie ne asoɔmmerɛ mu.
units.u021: Atwerɛsɛm nyinaa firi Onyankopɔn home mu, na ɛyɛ ma nkyerɛkyerɛ ne tenenee mu ntetee.
units.u026: Bue Bible no wɔ P2P mu ɛnnɛ.

07.title: Adesua wɔ P2P
07.description: Sɛdeɛ adesua yɛ adwuma wɔ P2P – adesua, abakɔsɛm, nhyehyɛeɛ, yɛmmɔ mu nsua, nsusuiɛ ne nyini.

units.u001: Adesua wɔ P2P mu nnyɛ adesua boaboa ano.
units.u002: Ɛyɛ nyini wɔ ntease mu, sɛdeɛ nokorɛ no bɛhyɛ sɛdeɛ wobɔ wo bra no kwan.
units.u003: Ma yɛnni osuani baako, Grace, akyi berɛ a n'akwantuo rekɔ so.
units.u004: Grace fi aseɛ wɔ Kingdom School.
units.u005: Fapem Nsɛm no to fapem a ɛyɛ den, modul baako biara: ɛfi aseɛ wɔ Peer-to-Peer nkyerɛkyerɛmu, afei Asɛmpa ne nkwagyeɛ, na ɛkɔ so kɔ Kristoni gyidie mu nneɛma titiriw.
units.u006: Sɛ wasiesie ne ho sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akyiri a, nsɛmti a wɔpa no ma nhyehyɛeɛ ne adesua wɔ nsɛmti bebree ho.
units.u007: Adesua biara bue Kyerɛwnsɛm, kyerɛkyerɛ mu yie, na ɛde nsɛmmisa a ɛboa no ma ɔte deɛ ɔkenkanee ase na ɔde di dwuma na ɛwie.
units.u008: Ka n'adesua ho no, Kingdom Stories bue Bible mu nnipa ne nsɛm a ɛsiiɛ, te sɛ Abraham, ɔbarima a ɔgyee Onyankopɔn bɔhyɛ diiɛ, a wɔka no tiri biara.
units.u009: Wɔ ɛkwan so, nsɛmmisa tiawa boa no ma ɔde n'ankasa nsɛm ka deɛ wasua.
units.u010: Sɛ ɔkyerɛw a, ɛboa nokorɛ no ma ɛfiri ne tiri mu kɔ ne koma mu.
units.u011: Sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔhwehwɛ asɛmti bi mu, te sɛ ɔdɔ a, P2P Nhyehyɛeɛ bɛtumi aboa no ma wayɛ n'ankasa adesua nhyehyɛeɛ, a Kyerɛwnsɛm, nkenkanee a ɛboa, ne mmerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata n'asetena wom.
units.u012: Adesua kɔ akyiri sene saa sɛ wo ne afoforɔ yɛ a.
units.u013: Ɛnam Yɛmmɔ Mu Nsua so, Grace bɛtumi afrɛ ne adamfo, n'Abusua Kuo, anaa n'asɔre ma wɔasua Kingdom Story anaa Kingdom School adesua abom.
units.u014: Obiara kura ne nkɔsoɔ, na ne nsusuiɛ tena kokoam gye sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde kyerɛ.
units.u015: N'Adesua Beaeɛ boaboa biribiara ano wɔ baabi baako: nsɛmmisa a ɛda so ara ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ, adwuma a ɔde ama, ne mmuaeɛ berɛ a ɛbɛba.
units.u016: Na wɔ n'asuafoɔ nkrataa mu, ɔkyerɛw ne nsusuiɛ.
units.u017: Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn akyerɛ no nnansa yi?
units.u018: Ɛdeɛn na ɛyɛ den ma no sɛ ɔde bɛyɛ adwuma?
units.u020: Berɛ a ɛrekɔ so no, wɔnam adanseɛ ankasa so kyerɛw ne nyini: adesua a ɔtee aseɛ, nokorɛ a ɔde dii dwuma, ne nnipa a ɔboaa wɔn.
units.u021: Anammɔn anammɔn, firi Aba so, kɔ Kwaeɛ Sifoɔ.
units.u022: Na berɛ a ɔrenyini no, ɔfi aseɛ boa afoforɔ: ɔfrɛ ne adamfo ma wɔne no sua, na da bi, ɔne obi a ɔrefi aseɛ nante.
units.u024: Kyerɛwnsɛm frɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ asɛm no yɛfoɔ, na ɛnyɛ atiefoɔ nko.
units.u025: Wɔ P2P mu, biribiara a wosua no, ɛsɛ sɛ wode bɔ wo bra, na wode ma afoforɔ.

overlays.l01: Nyini wɔ ntease mu, sɛdeɛ nokorɛ no bɛhyɛ wo asetena kwan
overlays.p12s:

overlays.l02: “Monntie asɛm no sɛ atiefoɔ kwa nsisi mo ho, na mmom, monyɛ asɛm no yɛfoɔ.”
overlays.l03: Sua nokorɛ no.  Fa nokorɛ no bɔ wo bra.  Boa obi foforɔ ma ɔnyini.

08.title: Asuafoɔ Yɛ Fi Aseɛ wɔ Fie
08.description: Abusua mu asuafoɔ yɛ ne Abusua Kuo: sua, bɔ mpaeɛ, na monnyini mmom wɔ fie.

units.u001: Ansa na abofra bɛtena sukuu dan mu anaa asɔre agua so no, ɔsua adeɛ wɔ fie.
units.u005: Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Ne nkurɔfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa Ne nsɛm nsie wɔn koma mu, na wɔmfa nhyɛ wɔn mma mu: berɛ a wɔte fie ne berɛ a wɔnam ɛkwan so.
units.u006: Fie asuafoɔ yɛ ntaa nyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa.
units.u007: Ɛte sɛ ɔwofoɔ a ɔkenkan Kyerɛwnsɛm wɔ didipono ho.
units.u008: Abusua a wɔbɔ mpaeɛ abom ansa na wɔada.
units.u009: Nana a ɔka sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn diii nokorɛ.
units.u010: Ne abofra asɛmmisa a ɛfata mmuaeɛ a ɛwɔ boasetɔ.
units.u011: Timoteo gyidie dii kan tenaa ne nana Lois ne ne maame Eunike mu.
units.u012: Mpɛn pii no, wɔnam abusua asetena a ɛyɛ daa so de gyidie ma, da biara.
units.u013: Ɛte nso sɛ awofoɔ a wɔtie: wɔma nokorɛ nsɛmmisa kwan, na wonsuro sɛ wɔbɛka sɛ: Mennim.
units.u015: P2P Abusua Kuo ma wo fiefoɔ beaeɛ a wɔbɛtena abom ayɛ yei.
units.u016: Yɛ wo kuo, na frɛ w'abusua.
units.u017: Fi nhyiamu bi ase ma ayeyi, Kyerɛwnsɛm, ne mpaeɛ.
units.u018: Momma abusua nkɔmmɔ nkɔ so wɔ nkrasɛm ne nne nkrasɛm so.
units.u019: Momfa mo abusua mpaeɛ abisadeɛ nkyerɛ, monsua mmom, na monhwɛ nhyiamu a mo ne mo bɔɔ mu no akyi.
units.u021: Mmofra bɛtumi ahunu gyidie a wɔde bɔ bra wɔ wɔn anim.
units.u022: Na abusua no nyinaa bɛtumi anyini abom.
units.u023: Ɛnsɛ sɛ asuafoɔ yɛ gyae wɔ asɔre pono ano.
units.u025: Na me ne me fie deɛ, yɛbɛsom Awurade.

overlays.l01: “Momfa nhyɛ mo mma mu. Sɛ mowɔ fie anaa monam ɛkwan so… monkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn.”
overlays.l02: “…gyidie a ɛfirii aseɛ firii wo nana Lois ne wo maame Eunike mu no…”
overlays.l03: Ɛnsɛ sɛ asuafoɔ yɛ gyae wɔ asɔre pono ano.
overlays.l04: “Na me ne me fie deɛ, yɛbɛsom Awurade.”
overlays.outro2: Na me ne me fie deɛ, yɛbɛsom Awurade.

09.title: Kingdom Stories
09.description: Bible mu nnipa ne nsɛm a ɛsiiɛ, a wɔka no tiri biara.

units.u001: Tete no, Onyankopɔn de ɔbarima bi a ne din de Abraham kɔɔ abɔnten, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmma n'ani so nhwɛ soro na ɔnkan nsoromma no, sɛ ɔbɛtumi a.
units.u005: Wɔfaa ɔman bi nnommum kɔeɛ, na wɔsane de wɔn baa fie.
units.u006: Na berɛ a mmerɛ no duruiɛ no, Onyankopɔn somaa ne Ba.
units.u008: Ɔno ne Deɛ bɔhyɛ biara kyerɛɛ No so.
units.u009: N'akyidifoɔ de asɛm no firii Yerusalem kɔɔ asase ano.
units.u010: Asɔre a ɛdi kan no boaboaa wɔn ho ano, bɔɔ mpaeɛ, huu amane, na ɛnyiniiɛ.
units.u011: Yei ne Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ abakɔsɛm mu ho asɛm.
units.u012: Na biribiara a wɔkyerɛw tete no, wɔkyerɛw de kyerɛkyerɛ yɛn, sɛdeɛ yɛbɛnya anidasoɔ.
units.u014: Nneɛma a ɛrenyini a ɛfa Bible mu nnipa ne nsɛm a ɛsiiɛ, ne Asɔre wɔ mmerɛ nyinaa mu ho.
units.u015: Hwehwɛ mu tiri biara, wɔ P2P Global.

overlays.l01: “Pagya wʼani hwɛ soro na hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi akan ɔsoro nsoromma anaa.”
overlays.l02: “Nanso, mmerɛ pa no duruiɛ no, Onyankopɔn somaa ne Ba…”
overlays.l03: “Biribiara a wɔatwerɛ wɔ Atwerɛsɛm no mu no, wɔatwerɛ de kyerɛkyerɛ yɛn sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a… yɛbɛnya anidasoɔ.”

10.title: Kingdom School
10.description: Bible adesua a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛto fapem a ɛyɛ den, adesua baako biara.

units.u001: Yesu kaa sɛ obiara a ɔte Ne nsɛm na ɔdi so no te sɛ onyansafoɔ a ɔsi ne dan wɔ ɔbotan so.
units.u002: Wɔsi asetena a ɛyɛ den wɔ fapem a ɛyɛ den so.
units.u003: Kingdom School yɛ P2P Global kwan a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛfa Kristoni gyidie mu nneɛma titiriw mu.
units.u004: Fapem Nsɛm no fi aseɛ wɔ Peer-to-Peer nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne Asɛmpa ne nkwagyeɛ, na ɛkɔ so anammɔn anammɔn wɔ adesua a ɛboro ɔha aduɔwɔtwe mu, na ɛredɔɔso.
units.u005: Nsɛmti a wɔpa no ma nhyehyɛeɛ ne adesua de kɔ akyiri.
units.u006: Adesua biara bue Kyerɛwnsɛm, kyerɛkyerɛ mu, na ɛhwɛ wo ntease, sɛdeɛ nimdeɛ bɛyɛ gyidie a emu yɛ den, na saa gyidie no bɛyɛ asetena a asesa.
units.u009: Bɔ wo bra wɔ nokorɛdie mu.

overlays.l01: “Wɔn a wɔtie deɛ meka, na wɔdi so no te sɛ onyansafoɔ a ɔsi ne dan si ɔbotan so.”
overlays.l02: Sua wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu.  Te aseɛ yie.  Bɔ wo bra wɔ nokorɛdie mu.
overlays.outro2: Kingdom School – wɔ P2P Global Adesua fa no mu.

11.title: Firi Adesua Kɔ Asetena Mu
11.description: Sɛdeɛ deɛ yɛsua no hyɛ da biara asetena, nkitahodie, gyinaeɛ, ne ɔsom kwan.

units.u001: Ɛfi aseɛ firi asɛm bi so.
units.u002: Nkyekyɛmu bi, a wɔkenkan anɔpa tutuutu, ansa na da no ayɛ dede.
units.u004: Ɔbue adesua bi, na ɔhwɛ deɛ ɛkyerɛ no yie.
units.u005: Na ɔbisa sɛ: ɛdeɛn na yei kyerɛ me fa Onyankopɔn ho?
units.u006: Na ɛdeɛn na ɛhwehwɛ firi me hɔ?
units.u010: Gyinaeɛ ketewa bi fa sɛdeɛ ɔbɛbɔ ne bra ɛnnɛ.
units.u011: Na afei da no fi aseɛ.
units.u013: Wɔ adwumam, ɔka nokorɛ, berɛ mpo a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ ɔrenka.
units.u014: Wɔ ne mpɔtam, ɔhunu obi a ɔhia mmoa, na ɔgyina.
units.u015: Kwasiada, ɔne n'asɔre som Onyankopɔn, na ɔtie Asɛm a wɔka.
units.u016: Wɔ ne babarima sukuu mu, ɔne abofra bi a ɛyɛ den ma no kenkan.
units.u017: Ɔne adamfo dada bi, ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde bɔne kyɛ.
units.u018: Adeɛ biara a ɔyɛ yɛ ketewa.
units.u019: Nanso emu biara yɛ Asɛm no, a wɔde bɔ bra.
units.u020: Kyerɛwnsɛm frɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnyɛ asɛm no yɛfoɔ, na ɛnyɛ atiefoɔ nko.
units.u021: Adamfo bi bisa no deɛ asesa.
units.u022: Enti ɔka deɛ ɔresua no kyerɛ no.
units.u023: Nnawɔtwe kakra akyi, saa adamfo no bue Kyerɛwnsɛm koro no ara, na ɔfi aseɛ nyini.
units.u024: Enti wɔfi aseɛ kenkan abom, nnawɔtwe biara prɛko.
units.u028: Na da bi, saa adamfo no nso bɛyɛ saa ara ama obi foforɔ.
units.u031: Nokorɛ a yɛnya no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛhyɛ sɛdeɛ yɛbɔ yɛn bra, ne sɛdeɛ yɛboa afoforɔ ma wɔnyini no kwan.
units.u033: Fa nokorɛ no bɔ wo bra.
